subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw ship the status-only Wear bridge first, or adopt this full conversations, voice, agents, and sessions companion as the initial Wear product?
rationale: Both implementations are open and overlap substantially, while this PR's release documentation explicitly leaves Wear publication and track selection to Android-owner approval.

options.title: Stage status first
options.body: Land the narrower status bridge as the first Wear slice and defer chat, voice, sessions, and publication until the boundary has shipped and stabilized.

options.title: Sponsor full companion
options.body: Adopt this broader branch after its correctness findings, exact-head physical proof, and release rollout are resolved.

recommendation.title: Stage status first
recommendation.body: Land the narrower status bridge as the first Wear slice and defer chat, voice, sessions, and publication until the boundary has shipped and stabilized.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android app owner, and the choice spans Android product scope, packaging, and release operations.
